# Firmable

Firmable's Partner API enriches company and people records, searches for people within companies, and returns supported search-filter metadata.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/firmable/.

## Actions

- **Enrich Company** (read-only): Look up one enriched company using at least one Firmable, LinkedIn, domain, ABN, or website identifier.
- **Enrich Person** (read-only): Look up one enriched person using a Firmable, LinkedIn, work-email, or personal-email identifier.
- **List Filter Options** (read-only): Return Firmable's current search filter codes and supported markets, optionally selecting filters or paging one location or industry filter.
- **Search People in Company** (read-only): Return one offset-based page of people at a Firmable company, optionally filtered by position, country, seniority code, or department code.
